detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Swipe the credit card through the ATM and bills land on the table. Steer the breaker over them and shred them. Every bill you destroy pays out, and the shreds go in the trash.

Electric bills arc to the bills next to them. Explosive bills blow up the stack around them. A burning bill sets its neighbours on fire. With the right upgrades, one hit clears the whole table.

Over 240 upgrades across the upgrade panels, the skill tree and the prestige tree. New bill types, bigger bundles, coins, diamonds, a flamethrower and a second ATM. Each branch changes how the table plays.

Destroying money also earns Prestige Points. When the shift slows down, end it and spend the points on permanent upgrades: an auto swiper, a second ATM, a combo meter. The next shift starts stronger and goes further.

Gold bills pay more, and their shockwave turns the bills around them gold. Diamonds shatter into shards that cut through the stacks. Stock certificates land in your tray: watch Bitcorn and Grandma's Tulip Fund rise and fall, and cash out at the right moment.

Keep destroying without a pause and the combo meter fills. Every Frenzy stage pays more, and the numbers on the table grow with it.

Your boss, Mr. Buck, calls in with instructions and opinions. "A trillion dollars. That's a one with twelve zeros. I had to order a wider monitor just to fit your balance on the screen."

  • Over 240 upgrades in three upgrade systems
  • Fire, lightning and explosions that chain from bill to bill
  • Gold bills, diamonds, coins and stock certificates
  • 47 Steam achievements
  • 31 languages
  • Your demo progress carries over to the full game
